Entry Carpenters Entry Carpenters Prices will change, trade routes will change, and what is truly lasting is people’s shared memory of risk, credit, and scarcity. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.

Entry Carpenters Entry Carpenters Prices will change, trade routes will change, and what is truly lasting is people’s shared memory of risk, credit, and scarcity. They may not necessarily understand ledgers, but they know the true weight of a bag of salt and a nail on the road.

Entry Carpenters Entry Carpenters Prices will change, trade routes will change, and what is truly lasting is people’s shared memory of risk, credit, and scarcity. Some people turn raw materials into tools, cloth and medicine, others set festivals and taboos for exchange; wealth is piled up by many hands, and rarely belongs to just one name.

Entry Carpenters Entry Carpenters Prices will change, trade routes will change, and what is truly lasting is people’s shared memory of risk, credit, and scarcity. If prices rise but wages do not, prosperity in distant places will only become thinner bread; if roads are safe, even small villages can get a little spring from trade.
